data.one_liner: A widget to parse text and extract parts using predefined types or Regex.
data.what_it_does: It parses text to render matching parts (like URLs, emails, phone numbers, or custom regex patterns) using different styles and tap callbacks.
use_when: You need to highlight and make specific parts of a text clickable (e.g., hashtags, mentions, URLs).
You want to avoid writing complex manual splitting logic for RichText strings.
avoid_when: You need full HTML rendering support instead of simple pattern matching.
strengths: Supports predefined types like URLs, emails, and phone numbers out of the box.
Allows custom regex patterns and display/value mapping.
weaknesses: Limited to pattern-based text parsing rather than full document layout.

alternatives.name: flutter_widget_from_html_core
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you need to render full HTML content rather than just matching regex patterns or specific types in plain text.
